IsValidDisplayMode (0xA0B6EE60): minimum width 1280 -> 800, so the UI-scaled mode is in the list the game picks from.
The main window's minimum size (0xA0C3FBF2, vtable +0x4C): height 720 -> 600.
The main window's minimum size: width 1280 -> 800.
